Between the jars: one small clay teapot in forest #3F5E4A glaze, one sprig of fresh rosemary lying on the middle shelf. Nothing else. At least 40 percent of the image is negative space (the bone wall).

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration with smooth soft-shaded volumes — like a premium wellness brand's marketing hero. Flat base colors with gentle gradient shading, NO painterly brushstrokes, NO watercolor texture, NO paper grain, NO sketchy edges. Warm diffuse light from upper right casts soft-edged shadows suggesting morning. No people, no text visible on labels, no other props. Use for the paywall / premium upsell hero.
